# 15 — Review security and privacy

## Objective
Review the synthetic application defensively for input/output, secrets, logging, dependency, access-control, and data exposure hygiene.
## Required context and areas
Inspect controller, Razor views, export, configuration, logs, dependencies, and seed data.
## Change constraints
Review-only. Do not create weaponised payloads, exploit instructions, or external-target automation.
## Response format
Evidence-backed finding, severity/confidence, safe impact, mitigation, verification, limitations.
## Assumptions
All data is fictional; distinguish risk from confirmed exploitability.
## Validation and evidence
Use safe local checks only; report exact commands and note that scanner results do not prove security.
